title: AttachedRecordService
responsibility: Loads one attached record from Git and validates the manifest and every file it consists of.

inputs.name: AttachedRecordService.constructor.root
inputs.description: Filesystem path of the repository root used to construct the evidence branch repository and LFS adapter. It determines where evidence history and LFS objects are read.

inputs.name: AttachedRecordService.constructor.within
inputs.description: Optional evidence commit that pins pointer validation to that commit’s history. Null rejects every pointer; when omitted, evidence is unpinned and each stored evidence commit can be followed.

inputs.name: AttachedRecordService.load.pointer
inputs.description: Pointer to a stored evidence directory, identifying its commit, directory path, and expected manifest hash. The commit must exist in the evidence branch and, when a pin is configured, belong to its history; the manifest hash must match the SHA-256 of manifest.json.

outputs.name: AttachedRecordService.load
outputs.description: Resolves to the attached record for the pointer, including the original pointer, a Map of readable file bytes keyed by file path, and any validation problems. The manifest and record are optional when their data is absent or invalid; each pointer key is read and hashed once per process.

inputs.name: AttachedRecordService.load.pointer

outputs.name: AttachedRecordService.load
outputs.description: Resolves to the attached record for the pointer, including the original pointer, a Map of readable file bytes keyed by file path, and any validation problems. The manifest and record are optional when their data is absent or invalid; each pointer key is read and hashed once per process.

outputs.name: AttachedRecordService.constructor
outputs.description: The constructed service instance, with an EvidenceBranchRepository and LfsAdapter rooted at root, the optional within pin, and an initially empty per-process load cache.
